# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/latest

Get the most recent non-prerelease, non-draft release sorted by created_at

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** optional · **ID:** `ep-241`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | Release ID |
| `tag_name` | string | Git tag name |
| `target_commitish` | string | Target branch/commit |
| `name` | string | Release title |
| `body` | string | Release notes |

| `published_at` | time.Time | Publish timestamp |
| `author` | *api.User | Publisher user |
| `assets` | []*api.Attachment | Release attachments |

- **404** — No non-draft, non-prerelease release exists or release is tag-only
- **500** — Database error

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Tag-only records (IsTag=true) are treated as non-existent releases and return 404 | validation | release.IsTag == true |
| Latest release excludes drafts, prereleases, and tag-only records | business_logic | is_draft=false AND is_prerelease=false AND is_tag=false |

### Error Paths

- **No qualifying release exists** → ctx.APIErrorNotFound → 404
- **Release is tag-only or wrong repo** → ctx.APIErrorNotFound → 404
- **DB error** → ctx.APIErrorInternal → 500
